newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Tourism to manage Sydney hotel.
newsitem.headline: Australian Tourism to manage Sydney hotel.

text.p: Hotel management group Australian Tourism Group said on Monday it has been selected to operate a planned A$100 million hotel for the Wharf at Woolloomooloo, near Sydney's central business district.

The 270 room, 4-1/2 star strata titled hotel at the Wharf at Woolloomooloo Bay, Sydney, is under development by Walker Corp Ltd and the privately owned Multiplex Constructions NSW Pty Ltd, Australian Tourism said.
It said it would call the new hotel The Chifley On The Wharf which will be the flagship of the new brand for the group.

The addition of The Chifley On The Wharf will lift the total number of rooms controlled by Australian Tourism Group and its associate company Touraust Corp around Australia to 2,794 rooms across 29 hotels from 2,524 rooms, Australian Tourism said.
The new hotel is expected to open in 1999.
Australian Tourism said it would develop the Chifley brand for all its city based hotels and will continue to develop its Country Comfort brand which will remain for the major regional hotels.

The Walker Corp/Multiplex joint venture for the Chifley on The Wharf was planning to sell the 270 rooms of the hotel on strata title and is seeking to register and issue a prospectus around October, Australian Tourism said.
It said Walker/Multiplex plans to sell hotel rooms at prices ranging from A$300,000 to A$500,000.
